text: I see you have an enlarged supraclavicular lymph node, which is often a sign of underlying pathology. Can you tell me more about the nature of your abdominal pain and if you have noticed any changes in your bowel habits or appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any difficulty swallowing, early satiety, or vomiting that might suggest a gastrointestinal obstruction? I need to determine if the abdominal pain is related to an underlying malignancy or infection.
